first.rationale: The competitor’s entry pricing directly threatens the segment where targeted promotional pricing previously produced strong acquisition and revenue lift. Verify the pricing result and the onboarding alternative before committing; run a targeted, time-bounded SMB experiment with qualified-revenue and post-promotion retention guardrails to avoid buying low-value or discount-dependent demand.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment for self-serve accounts. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and is supported by verified evidence of higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention—outcomes aligned with sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified retention decline makes it unsuitable for the primary objective despite competitive pressure.
